gate_rationale: Frozen on 2026-11-06 before any main-seed or hidden-seed run. Pilot seeds 9201-9202 (about 530 questions each over 20 categories) gave reasoner-oracle agreement 1.000 overall and per category, lookup agreement 0.000 on derived categories, paraphrase consistency 1.000, counterfactual and provenance checks 40/40, every operator ablation dropping its target categories by 1.0 with no collateral, and the binding ablation dropping derived categories by 0.91-0.96. Gates leave margin below those values. Pilot runs led to three fixes before freezing: 'inside' in questions was not normalized, positive derived categories also collected inherited 'no' answers, and number cleanup was slow; none changed a threshold.
